post:
Most energy reports are late for one reason.

The data sits in twelve places. Someone copies it into a spreadsheet, checks it, and copies it again. By the time the report lands, the month has moved on.

Our pilot sites changed that. They pulled meter data into one view and cut monthly reporting time by 40%. The team spent the saved hours on the work that matters: finding waste and fixing it.

Chapter 3 of our guide shows how they organised it, site by site, with the checks they kept and the steps they dropped.

Link in the first comment.
